info.title: SDKWork Partner Backend API
info.description: Backend administration API for the multi-level partner (agent) management system: levels and commission ratios, partners, join fees, customer bindings, commission events and settlements, ledger, withdrawals, and stats.

post.summary: Restore the commercial default level catalog (seven-tier pyramid).
post.description: Restores the default seven-tier catalog for the tenant. Mode "fill" (default) inserts or revives only the missing default levels and never touches active levels the operator configured; mode "reset" additionally overwrites the active default levels with catalog values (existing row ids are kept, operator-created levels beyond the catalog are never touched).

post.description: Approves the application (SUBMITTED → APPROVED) and creates the partner record in the same transaction using the existing partner creation path (status PENDING, bound to the applicant, inviter chain from the invite code, assigned level and invite code).
Rejects the application (SUBMITTED → REJECTED) with a required reason; the applicant may submit a new application afterwards.

unboundBy.description: Operator id that unbound the customer.

restored.description: Levels inserted or revived from soft-delete.

reset.description: Levels overwritten with the default catalog (reset mode only).

skipped.description: Existing active levels left untouched (fill mode only).

inviteCode.description: Invite code submitted with the application (original input).

inviterPartnerId.description: Inviter partner id locked at submit time (null = no invite code).

reviewComment.description: Review comment (approval note or rejection reason).

reviewerUserId.description: Reviewer user id (null = not reviewed yet).

approvedPartnerId.description: Partner record created on approval (closed loop reference).

inviterPartnerName.description: Inviter partner display name (empty when the application carried no invite code or the inviter was deleted).

inviterLevelNo.description: Inviter partner level number (null when the application carried no invite code).

levelNo.description: Partner level number assigned on approval.
